prompt:
Fix the snippet snippets/seasonal-closure-notice.liquid. It shows the dates on which the store is closed for the holidays. Input (a top-level variable, not under section.settings): - closure_dates: an array of strings, or null. It may be empty. Each entry is a non-null, non-empty string such as "December 25". Output rules: - When closure_dates has at least one entry, output exactly:

Closed: DATES

DATES is every entry in input order, separated by a comma followed by one space (", "). - There is no separator before the first entry or after the last entry. - A single entry has no separator. - HTML-escape the date text: & < > " ' become & < > " '. - Do not output any whitespace or newlines before or after the

element. - When closure_dates is null or empty, output nothing (an empty string). Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/seasonal-closure-notice.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
